# Third-party notices

## Game inspiration

Last Hex is inspired by Black Hole, a pen-and-paper game by Walter Joris.
Reference: https://mathwithbaddrawings.com/2020/04/22/six-strategic-games-from-a-strange-and-bottomless-mind/

## Fonts

The page requests DM Sans and Space Grotesk through Google Fonts. Both use the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Font binaries are not included in this download; local fallback fonts are used when Google Fonts is unavailable.

- DM Sans license: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/dmsans/OFL.txt
- Space Grotesk license: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/spacegrotesk/OFL.txt

If you bundle these fonts for self-hosting, retain their respective copyright and license notices with the font files. The project's MIT License does not replace these font licenses.
